newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Wednesday, with buyers taking to the sidelines amid falls in Malaysia, traders said.
They said palm olein was generally quoted at 1,370-75 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but trades were also heard at five rupiah above and below the range.

"The market was reasonably active in the morning session, but slowed down after prices in Malaysia began coming down," one trader said. "Buyers are taking a wait-and-see attitude and buying interest will depend on leads from Malaysia. Traders said prices should hold their ground through the week.
